verdict.rationale: Whether a business-planning SaaS publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a public source repository or an open-source license. The mentions of 'open APIs' describe integration access, which is an adjacent feature and does not make the source readable under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
